item.title: UN approves new map showing Africa’s true size
item.description:
Togo-sponsored resolution called to phase out traditional map that depicts continent as similar size to Greenland The United Nations has voted to adopt a resolution for the world to formally phase out the traditional Mercator map of the globe in favour of one that more accurately displays Africa’s size. In a session at its headquarters in New York, the UN general assembly officially retired the 16th-century Mercator projection in favour of one based on the more accurate 2018 Equal Earth design. item.title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial has divided US on whether she's victim or criminal
item.description:
The nearly six-week murder trial for Lindsay Clancy, a woman accused of strangling her three children before attempting to kill herself in 2023, has been a fixture for women across the United States. Some gathered inside and outside the courthouse in Plymouth, Massachusetts, to show support for Clancy. Others posted videos on social media detailing their opinions on the case or sharing the ways Clancy’s story resonated with their own. Clancy’s defense team had argued that the former labor and delivery nurse should not be held criminally responsible for the deaths of her children because she had been experiencing postpartum psychosis , a life-threatening medical condition that alters a person’s perception of reality after childbirth . About 1 to 2 in every 1,000 people experience postpartum psychosis after giving birth, research shows . Her lawyers said Clancy sought extensive treatment…

item.title: News Wrap: 2 men rescued from Nepal tunnel 9 days after catastrophic flood
item.description:
Officials say pair were rescued from Trishuli 3A hydropower tunnel in Nepal after being trapped at depth of 170 metres Two people have been pulled out alive from a hydropower tunnel in Nepal nine days after deadly flash floods buried the projects in deep mud and left them trapped. The workers were rescued during an operation at the Trishuli 3A tunnel, a hydropower project in one of the areas worst affected by last week’s floods , according to the army spokesperson Brig Gen Raja Ram Basnet. item.description:

I don’t feel eight was too many. I could run to nine. Amazing, really, that it’s been as long as a few weeks since Farage had a crash-out and forced a byelection. item.title: Gloria Steinem: A life in pictures
item.description:
For years, when interviewers asked for a favorite quote, I gave them Gloria Steinem’s: “We are linked, not ranked.” She used the line in 2013 as shorthand for her whole political vision. Women are not a tournament. We are not climbing over one another toward a single chair. We thrive when we treat our connection as a circle instead of a hierarchy. I needed that line. In corporate life in the 1990s and early 2000s, the conventional wisdom held that there was room for only a few of us in executive team rooms and that the smart play was to swat the woman next to you out of the way. Steinem’s sentence rejected that scarcity story. The problem was the ranking, not the other woman. I am a feminist. I adopted the word in college. Before that I was an athlete training eight hours a day, with no political opinions to speak of. What I had was a body that coaches treated as theirs to break and use…
